removalCriteria: Overall 4.7 on WIDA ACCESS is the state proficiency threshold for reclassification
At 4.7-6.0 the district must exit unless the EL Portfolio contradicts the score
Below 4.7 a pupil may still be reclassified on a body of grade-level evidence
Exit is conditional: two years of monitoring follow, with no ACCESS testing in them
A monitored pupil in difficulty can be re-entered and resumes annual ACCESS testing

evidence.bullet: Overall 4.7 on WIDA ACCESS is the state proficiency threshold for reclassification
evidence.quote: Missouri defines English proficiency as achieving a minimum overall score of 4.7 on the WIDA ACCESS

evidence.bullet: At 4.7-6.0 the district must exit unless the EL Portfolio contradicts the score
evidence.quote: The student must be exited barring compelling evidence in the EL Portfolio suggesting the student should remain in the LIEP

evidence.bullet: Below 4.7 a pupil may still be reclassified on a body of grade-level evidence
evidence.quote: Students with scores below 4.7 may be reclassified if the district has collected a sufficient body of evidence showing that the student can perform at grade level

evidence.bullet: Exit is conditional: two years of monitoring follow, with no ACCESS testing in them
evidence.quote: ESSA requires that reclassified ELs be monitored for two years following their exit from the LIEP

evidence.bullet: A monitored pupil in difficulty can be re-entered and resumes annual ACCESS testing
evidence.quote: students resume participation in all components of the program, including annual WIDA ACCESS testing, as if they had not exited
